title: WASI components, HTTP MCP and scalable execution — agent-panel evaluation

panel_protocol.limitation: Source-verified and fixture-proven implementation only; live Wasmtime guest execution, production cluster scaling, and prospective OAuth-gated multi-tenant cloud deployments remain gated.

inter_rater_agreement.agreement_notes: All three panel roles converged independently on approval. Convergence centered on: (1) WIT search-provider ABI contract decoupling and static capability/memory/fuel bounds; (2) Ed25519 cryptographic release signing with length-prefixed domain separation and fail-closed key revocation; (3) 4-slot local MCP task admission with cooperative cancellation and recovery; (4) non-authoritative form elicitation that never grants effect authority; (5) subscription filtering restricted to aggregate task-activity notifications; and (6) rigorous preservation of open maturity gates (Wasmtime runtime execution, Arrow/DuckDB engines, and authenticated Streamable HTTP/OAuth under Track 34).
convergence_vectors: WIT search-provider package world searchright:provider@0.1.0 cleanly separating host and guest interfaces
Ed25519 detached signature verification over canonical length-prefixed domain-separated release messages
Fail-closed cryptographic key revocation and validity window enforcement
Local MCP stdio 4-slot task concurrency limit with immediate capacity recovery upon cancellation
Interactive form elicitation returning non-authoritative structured acknowledgements without effect authority
Aggregate task-activity resource subscription filtering excluding arbitrary file/remote URIs
Multi-era MCP compatibility supporting 2026-07-28 discovery and 2025-11-25 initialization
Candidate OpenAPI 3.1.0 specifications preserving strict denial of unauthenticated remote execution without Track 34
divergence_vectors: Dynamic percentile-based fuel consumption allocations versus static max_fuel bounds
Long-polling versus Server-Sent Events transport integration for future Track 34 Streamable HTTP

assertions_evaluated.notes: WIT host/guest interfaces in contracts/wit/search-provider.wit and Ed25519 signed manifest release verification in searchright-plugin-sdk verified by unit tests, component_sandbox_scenarios.rs, component_edges.rs, and test_wasi_http_scale_governance.py.

Static capability controls (ComponentCapability), memory bounds (max_memory_mib), fuel allocations (max_fuel), and network endpoint allowlists verified in searchright-plugin-sdk and searchright-policy; Wasmtime runtime fuel metering remains an explicit open gate.

StudyGraph and FileReviewStore contracts verified against large-corpus schema requirements; columnar Arrow/Parquet and DuckDB engine integration properly preserved as open gate pending scalable execution benchmarks.

Bounded local-stdio MCP server implements 2026-07-28 discovery, 4-slot task admission with cancellation and recovery, non-authoritative form elicitation, and aggregate task-activity subscriptions in advanced_mcp.rs; Streamable HTTP preserved as open gate.

Candidate HTTP OpenAPI 3.1.0 routes and local MCP listener bindings verified in searchright-http.openapi.yaml and test_wasi_http_scale_governance.py; authenticated Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.0 proxy tokens, and multi-tenant quotas denied pending Track 34 governance.

Multi-era MCP compatibility (2026-07-28 and 2025-11-25) and local 4-slot task admission overload, rejection, cancellation, and recovery tested in advanced_mcp.rs; WASI and remote chaos/failover preserved as open gate.

panel_recommendations: Retain length-prefixed domain-separated release messages for all component cryptographic signatures.
Preserve strict 4-slot local task limits and non-authoritative form elicitation bounds across MCP endpoints.
Maintain honest claim boundaries distinguishing source-verified contracts from live Wasmtime, Arrow/DuckDB, and remote Streamable HTTP execution.
open_gates: Compile WASI components and run the component conformance suite.
Implement and compile the WIT host/guest boundary with Wasmtime resource controls.
Implement Arrow, Parquet and DuckDB large-corpus storage and query paths.
Implement and threat-model authenticated Streamable HTTP/OAuth transport.
Execute remote or distributed overload, disconnect, chaos, failover and production-cache tests beyond bounded local task admission.
Establish accountable publisher identity, protected key custody, registry distribution, transparency and observed revocation propagation beyond the local Ed25519 admission boundary.
